description: This file defines the KafkaPublisherActor class, which handles publishing messages to Kafka within an Akka actor framework. It manages Kafka producer lifecycle, message sending, and error handling, specifically for the Eclipse Ditto project. The class is responsible for integrating Kafka messaging into the system, supporting graceful shutdowns, and converting exceptions to acknowledgements.

classes.name: KafkaPublisherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for publishing messages to Kafka, managing producer lifecycle, handling acknowledgments, and error scenarios within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: GracefulStop
classes.description: A singleton class used as a message to trigger graceful shutdown of the KafkaPublisherActor.

classes.name: ProducerCallBack
classes.description: Implements Kafka's Callback to handle asynchronous send completion, creates acknowledgements, and manages quota-based payload sizing.

classes.name: KafkaExceptionConverter
classes.description: Converts exceptions from Kafka operations into HTTP status codes for acknowledgement and error handling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration object for instantiating KafkaPublisherActor with given connection, factory, and dryRun setting.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup upon actor shutdown, closing the Kafka producer.

methods.name: getExceptionConverter
methods.description: Returns the exception to acknowledgement converter used by the actor.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Defines message patterns for dry-run message dropping and graceful stop initiation.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines whether to publish acknowledgments based on its label.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts a string address into a KafkaPublishTarget object.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Publishes an ExternalMessage to Kafka asynchronously, returning a CompletionStage of CommandResponse.

methods.name: escalateIfNotRetryable
methods.description: Escalates non-retryable exceptions to the parent actor.

methods.name: producerRecord
methods.description: Constructs a ProducerRecord for Kafka from the publish target and external message payload and headers.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageHeaders
methods.description: Maps ExternalMessage headers into Kafka RecordHeader objects.

methods.name: mapExternalMessagePayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload string from ExternalMessage, depending on message type.

methods.name: closeProducer
methods.description: Closes the Kafka producer if it is open.

methods.name: stopInternalKafkaProducer
methods.description: Stops internal Kafka producer, with logging.

methods.name: reportInitialConnectionState
methods.description: Logs that the publisher is ready and signals success to parent.

methods.name: stopGracefully
methods.description: Triggers graceful shutdown of the actor.
